top: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 2D game SOLID CEILING WALL, matching the approved SPACE wall's functional geometry. Image 1 is a MATERIAL/STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its warm golden sandstone blocks with restrained teal Egyptian-style ornamental insets, small cracks and sparse chipped rubble. Image 2 is the APPROVED WALL SHAPE reference: copy its deep continuous mass and very shallow, almost horizontal inward contact face. Create one standalone 2:1 PNG (requested 3072x1536) with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA on the playable side. Dense solid material fills the full width from the TOP canvas edge down to roughly 85% height; bottom 15% is transparent. LOWER wall contour is almost level across the full width. Only tiny natural chips/bumps at the contact edge, at most 1% of total image height. It must read as an impassable continuous WALL at a flat collision plane, not decorative foreground hills. Many rows of small-to-medium interlocking material elements; no giant enlarged blocks. Entire outward depth and outer edges are filled with solid material; no transparent holes through the mass and no floating pieces. Preserve full tiny edge silhouettes in alpha, never slice a large rock/structure in half. Crisp illustrated side-view game art, clean dark outlines, matching reference palette and texture detail. No pyramids, dunes, sky, distant ruins, columns sticking into the arena, or large hanging architecture. NO background of any kind on the open side, no black background, no checkerboard painted in, no blur, no fade, no repeated narrow strip, no text, no UI, no characters. Material differs from Space, geometry matches Space.
